workUnit: SmartAIHub R5 SPEC-269 same-tenant App isolation

directCases: App A cannot read Project B memory when only App B is bound to Project B
App B with current tenant membership and Project binding can read Project B memory
Global scoped and entity memory remain available across the App mismatch
Project context restores after the test to avoid contaminating later cases
result.database: PostgreSQL 17.11, loopback-only miniapp_r5_test, synthetic fixture rows only

reviewedSecurityLenses: Both Apps use the same canonical tenant
Each App has a unique canonical and public App identity
Project B has one current App binding, to App B
Project membership is current for the tested principal
App A context is rejected for Project B despite same-tenant identity
App B context authorizes only its bound Project B
Project A memory is excluded from App B Project B context
Project B entity memory is excluded from App A context
Global scoped and entity memories remain permitted under existing policy
Conversation retarget is reverted in finally even when an assertion fails
Cleanup remains restricted to generated tenant and fixture identities
No client Host headers, schema migration, durable write, deployment, or protected dispatch
limitations: This proves App-to-Project binding isolation for the persisted prompt path; it does not prove App-private memory isolation or close T-01.
Production ingress producer and deployed route provenance remain unverified; context is synthetic and server-side.
